theorems.name: Submission.cmr_df_cons_sum_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (I : Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (A : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1)) (L : Euclid P → Euclid P), (∀ v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) → (∀ (v : Euclid P) (k : Fin (m + 1)), L v (I k) = A (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k' => v (I k'))) k) → ∀ w : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P, ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * θ (Fin.cons (L (w i)) (i.removeNth w)) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) A * θ w
